name: b4_sound_check
_about: Lane B4: records 24 s of the game's own sound (walk, sprint, a 57 mm shot and its casing, reload, a jump and landing, another shot) to sound-check.wav in the run folder. The Dummy driver still mixes, so this works off screen. tools/bot_run.sh b4_sound_check Part 2: turns in place for 3 s from 24 s (the hum Emerson heard rose with turning) and records to 28 s. Music is muted for the check (it measures the effects mix). A 1 s sub-gun (12.7 mm) burst at 22.5 s.
